MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The original J-B Weld epoxy fits my interest in small, durable repairs, which connects naturally to my purchases of duct tape and vinyl cement.",
    "The reinforced strapping tape offers a useful complement to my duct tape for bundling and securing materials, giving me a related tool with a distinct purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The deck screws, drywall anchors and precisely sized nuts require specific projects I have not indicated I am doing.",
    "Buying a handtruck does not mean I need workbench casters or replacement wheels; moving things and modifying equipment are different needs.",
    "The large epoxy pack and another substantial connector assortment feel unnecessary without a repair planned or a reason to replace what I already have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of practical repair supplies seem to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop hardware.",
    "My Gorilla tape purchases make another Gorilla product worth considering, but the shared brand does not establish a need for construction adhesive."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in versatile supplies for small repairs than hardware that requires an exact size, installation or building project.",
    "A related purchase needs to offer a useful new purpose; already owning a large connector assortment makes another assortment less compelling.",
    "Interest alone does not mean I would buy now: pack size and having a concrete job matter to my decision."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repairs but stretched it into project-specific hardware and extra supplies I do not currently need."
}
